test.summary: SPM - OKR - Updating and Deleting Select custom field options in Settings
test.description:
This test verifies updating, deleting and adding Select custom field options in Settings.

Covered areas:

* Settings → Fields
* OKR Detail page
* Overview (inline editing)
* Side panel

Validation scope:

* Editing and saving Select custom field option names
* Adding new Select custom field options
* Deleting existing Select custom field options
* Verifying warning message displayed before deleting option values used by OKR items
* Verifying assigned values are removed after deleting Select option
* Verifying updated and newly added option values are displayed correctly across all supported OKR views
* Verifying deleted option values are no longer available

rag.text:
Test: TC-6151 — SPM - OKR - Updating and Deleting Select custom field options in Settings
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/OKR/TS-512 OKR - OKR module
Labels: spm-mikolaj-tc

Description:
This test verifies updating, deleting and adding Select custom field options in Settings.

Covered areas:

* Settings → Fields
* OKR Detail page
* Overview (inline editing)
* Side panel

Validation scope:

* Editing and saving Select custom field option names
* Adding new Select custom field options
* Deleting existing Select custom field options
* Verifying warning message displayed before deleting option values used by OKR items
* Verifying assigned values are removed after deleting Select option
* Verifying updated and newly added option values are displayed correctly across all supported OKR views
* Verifying deleted option values are no longer available 

Steps:
1. *Preconditions:*

* Select custom field is created and assigned to Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result (used-in)
* Existing OKRs contain predefined values for Select fields
* User has permissions to edit OKRs and custom field values
   Expected: 
2. Open OKR Overview of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-6151 SPM - OKR - Updating and Deleting Select custom field options in Settings
   Expected: Overview module is opened. The following OKRs are visible:

* Strategic theme 1
* Objective 1
* Key result 1
3. Navigate to Select field
   Expected: Select field is visible for Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result.

The following text field values are displayed correctly for each item:

* Strategic Theme - "High"
* Objective - "Medium"
* Key Result - "Low"
4. Navigate to OKR settings → Fields
   Expected: List of fields are displayed
5. Navigate to fieldName and Click in tree dots button → Edit
   Data: fieldName: Select field
   Expected: "Edit custom field" modal is displayed.
Select custom field options are displayed correctly:

* Value 1: High
* Value 2: Medium
* Value 3: Low
6. delete old and fill in new values
   Data: newValue:

* High → Critical
* Medium → Major
* Low → Minor
   Expected: new value filled
7. Click + Add button and add newValue, click Save
   Data: newValue:  Blocker
   Expected: Edit modal closed
8. Open Overview and navigate to select field
   Expected: new field value is changed and displayed correctly

* Strategic theme → Critical
* Objective → Major
* Key result → Minor
9. Navigate to Key result and select field value
   Expected: Dropdown with available Select custom field values is displayed correctly and contains newly added option (Blocker)
10. change the value
   Data: newValue: Blocker
   Expected: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly in Overview
11. Click on the grey area of the Key result row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Key result. Select field is visible with correct value.
12. Open Key result in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
   Expected: Detail page is opened. Select field is visible with correct value.
13. Navigate to Settings → Fields → Select field → click Tree dots button → edit
   Expected: Edit field modal is opened
14. Click the delete button next to the "Critical" Select custom field option
   Expected: Delete confirmation dialog is displayed with information " _This value is used in 1 strategic theme. Deleting it will permanently erase the assigned data_."
15. Click Delete
   Expected: Value disappear from values list
16. Click Save button
   Expected: Edit modal closed
17. Open Overview and navigate to Strategic theme Select field
   Expected: Select field displays empty field for Strategic theme
